title: Medicarpin triggers Fas cell surface death receptor-mediated apoptosis by inhibiting epidermal growth factor receptor/signal transducer and activator of transcription 3 pathway and protective autophagy in liver cancer.
authors: Li, Yong-Zhuo; Huang, Chun-Ping; Li, Jing; Wang, Jia-Jun; Yan, Jin; Liu, Zhao-Ji; Feng, Ji; Yang, Xiao-Mei; Huang, Xiao-Wei; Cui, Jianzhou; Lu, Guo-Dong; Zhou, Jing
journal: Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究天然化合物Medicarpin通过EGFR/STAT3通路诱导肝癌凋亡，无蛋白质-DNA互作、结合位点预测或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Liver cancer remains the leading cause of cancer-related mortality worldwide, highlighting the need for novel therapeutics. Medicarpin is a pterocarpan, an isoflavonoid derivative, isolated from Spatholobus suberectus Dunn, exhibiting diverse bioactivities, yet its anticancer potential in liver cancer and underlying mechanisms are not well characterized. PURPOSE: This study aims to investigate the therapeutic efficacy of medicarpin against liver cancer and to elucidate its molecular mechanisms, focusing on its interplay with the epidermal growth factor receptor (EGFR)/signal transducer and activator of transcription 3 (STAT3) signaling and autophagy regulation. METHODS: A series of in vitro and in vivo assays were conducted to assess medicarpin's effects on apoptosis, EGFR stability, STAT3 signaling and autophagy in liver cancer cells. Molecular docking, cellular thermal shift assay, and drug affinity responsive target stability were employed to confirm target engagement. In vivo efficacy was evaluated using HepG2 xenograft models. RESULTS: Medicarpin selectively induced apoptosis in liver cancer cells while sparing normal hepatocytes. This effect was independent of p53 status and was mediated through upregulation and membrane accumulation of Fas (Fas cell surface death receptor). Mechanistically, medicarpin directly bound to EGFR, promoted its ubiquitin-mediated degradation, and consequently suppressed the EGFR-STAT3 signaling pathway. Furthermore, medicarpin concurrently triggered protective autophagy, and its inhibition synergistically enhanced its cytotoxicity. In xenograft models, medicarpin significantly suppressed tumor growth. CONCLUSION: Our findings identify medicarpin as a novel EGFR‑modulating natural compound that induces Fas-mediated apoptosis in liver cancer, independent of p53 status. The concomitant induction of protective autophagy presents a rational combinatory strategy to enhance its therapeutic efficacy. This study underscores the translational potential of medicarpin as a promising candidate for phytotherapy-based liver cancer treatment.
abstract_zh: 背景：肝癌仍然是全球癌症相关死亡的主要原因，凸显了对新型疗法的需求。美迪紫檀素 (medicarpin) 是一种紫檀烷类化合物，属于异黄酮衍生物，从密花豆 (Spatholobus suberectus Dunn) 中分离得到，具有多种生物活性，但其在肝癌中的抗癌潜力及潜在机制尚未得到充分表征。目的：本研究旨在探讨美迪紫檀素对肝癌的治疗效果，并阐明其分子机制，重点关注其与表皮生长因子受体 (EGFR)/信号转导与转录激活因子3 (STAT3) 信号通路及自噬调控的相互作用。方法：开展一系列体外和体内实验，以评估美迪紫檀素对肝癌细胞凋亡、EGFR稳定性、STAT3信号通路及自噬的影响。采用分子对接、细胞热位移分析及药物亲和响应靶标稳定性实验来确认靶点结合。使用HepG2异种移植模型评估体内疗效。结果：美迪紫檀素选择性诱导肝癌细胞凋亡，同时不损伤正常肝细胞。该效应不依赖于p53状态，并通过上调Fas（Fas细胞表面死亡受体）及其膜积聚介导。机制上，美迪紫檀素直接结合EGFR，促进其泛素介导的降解，从而抑制EGFR-STAT3信号通路。此外，美迪紫檀素同时触发保护性自噬，而抑制自噬可协同增强其细胞毒性。在异种移植模型中，美迪紫檀素显著抑制肿瘤生长。结论：我们的研究结果将美迪紫檀素鉴定为一种新型EGFR调节天然化合物，以不依赖p53状态的方式诱导肝癌中Fas介导的凋亡。伴随的保护性自噬诱导为增强其治疗疗效提供了合理的联合策略。本研究强调了美迪紫檀素作为基于植物疗法的肝癌治疗候选药物的转化潜力。
